materialStats.title: Material analytics
materialStats.description: What students actually did with each material in the selected period. Only recorded events are counted — an empty period shows zeros.
materialStats.notes: A view is a student opening the material (counted at most once per 30 minutes per student). Completion = students who marked it completed in the period (an undone mark is not counted); the rate is completions ÷ viewers, shown as — when nobody viewed it. Tests belong to a topic, so the test column shows attempts on the topic's tests, not on this material alone. Administrators' own opens are not counted.
